name: China Southern Power Grid Energy Storage Co., Ltd.
summary: Yunnan Wenshan Electric Power Co.,Ltd specializes in the generation and distribution of hydroelectric power. With an approximate capacity of 110,000 kilowatts, it provides electricity supply services throughout Wenshan Prefecture, including the regions of Neiwenshan, Yanshan, Qiubei, Funing, and Xichou. The company also extends its expertise to power grid planning and construction. Established in 1997, its operations are based in Wenshan, China.
